creative_ops.algorithm: Provenance-aware question and original angle; reject unrelated or near-duplicate video concept.

creative_ops.output_contract: ResearchDossier (v2: immutable verified revision + evidence/source IDs)
creative_ops.algorithm: Freeze permitted factual claims; missing critical source blocks production.
Load real domain visual/voice rules; no generic theme swap or disabled domain.
Ask/promise, evidence, uncertainty, payoff, and duration ranges; mark claims by ID.
Visual class, permitted source, image/video overlay, speech cue, motion, source & rights dependencies.
Delegate adjudication to existing rights service, unknown legal basis -> HOLD.

creative_ops.input_contract: Original source context + documented rights + commentary
creative_ops.algorithm: Require real new independent critique and source-to-commentary link. No generic green-screen license. When source clips are absent, record NOT_APPLICABLE as a durable guard result; downstream stages must not treat a skipped required guard as approval.

Generate original diagrams or use authorized assets; GPU only if tested/available. Mandatory clip-review guard returns signed NOT_APPLICABLE if no third-party clips; otherwise requires reviewed ReactionClipMap.
Synth/import voice, measure speech segment duration and align real timing.

creative_ops.input_contract: Master story + source-verified claim set + locale profile
creative_ops.algorithm: Meaning-preserving adaptation, region-safe numbers/names; regenerate text/audio/timing.
Native-script caption and semantic text tracks; collision, safe box and contrast checks.
Track-based mix, speech-first intelligibility, loudness evidence and rights.

creative_ops.input_contract: Shots + overlays + aligned speech + mix + locale
creative_ops.algorithm: Immutable half-open millisecond interval graph, source/rights hashes, scene continuity.
CPU FFmpeg or optional GPU provider, reproducible render manifest and bounded retry.

creative_ops.input_contract: Actual rendered file + source and rights hashes
Actual final rendered revision + QC + rights status
creative_ops.algorithm: Manual full watch-through; content-specific acceptance, material edits void approval.
Private export always supported; upload only after correct credentials/policy. Studio dubbing manual handoff.
Use actual owner observations only, compare matched cohorts with uncertainty.
